# MacExplorer

A native SwiftUI file manager with Explorer-style navigation and macOS integration.

## Included

Tabbed windows, expandable folder navigation, native file views and table customization, Quick Access, file operations and recovery, bulk rename, ZIP creation and guarded extraction, Spotlight/recursive search, Quick Look, sharing, tags, properties, volumes, network discovery, and opt-in system integrations.

Download the universal DMG or ZIP for macOS 14 and later. Source and standalone interactive-design ZIPs are also included. `SHA256SUMS` covers the published artifacts. Sparkle verifies the update archive and signed appcast using the public key embedded in the app.

Read `INSTALL.md` and the repository capability matrix. This release does not replace Finder's protected system components or claim every Windows-only Explorer feature. Back up important data before evaluating file-management software.
